$comment: Hardened permissions for the claude-code-action REVIEW job (the tool-bearing final pass). The cardinal rule — only deterministic apply writes src/data and merges — is enforced HERE by path-scoped permissions, not by zero-tools: the agent may Edit/Write only under .discovery/reviewed/, and may fetch only through the SSRF-guarded discover-verify wrapper (.github/discovery-verify.sh). EVERY interpreter is denied (node/bun/deno/python/perl/ruby/sh/...), so the agent cannot run `node -e '<env dump>'` or `node /tmp/x.js` to read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from process.env — the ONLY way to reach the network is the committed, agent-unwritable wrapper, which execs discover-verify.js (forces every hop through src/lib/ssrf-guard.ts). Deny is enforced by Claude Code core semantics regardless of headless defaults; the GITHUB_TOKEN is contents:read-only so even a full bypass cannot push. Git push/commit, gh pr create/merge, and every env-reading command are also denied. Secrets are env->provider transport only; the agent's Bash context never receives them (the workflow job omits them from the action's env).
